revocation_note: App does not host revoke. Optional — do not require /oauth/revoke.
notes: Prefix paths with MIDKERNEL_APP_URL (production includes Next basePath /app). Prefer RFC 8414 metadata authorize/token/register when discovery succeeds. IT production redirect allowlist is exact (Cursor Agents + Grok Bot). localhost / cursor:// / vscode:// are DCR defaults only — not required on the allowlist. Do not invent other redirect URIs. If the app AS routes are not live, the plugin returns AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED and never invents a token or run.
